app'icchatā sappurisehi vaṇṇitā, makkhappahānaṃ vūpasamo dukhassa, iti'ssu maṃ citta tadā niyuñjasi, idāni tvaṃ gacchasi pubbaciṇṇaṃ.

evam'eva kho, aggivessana, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena c'eva cittena ca kāmehi vūpakaṭṭhā viharanti… abhabbā'va te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto vihareyyan'ti

so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena sampādeti, kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca.

70131.meaning1: fact of having a calm mind; fact of having a settled heart

examples.text: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, vūpasantacittataṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.
app'icchatā sappurisehi vaṇṇitā, makkhappahānaṃ vūpasamo dukhassa, iti'ssu maṃ citta tadā niyuñjasi, idāni tvaṃ gacchasi pubbaciṇṇaṃ.

uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.

70136.grammar: adj, in comps, from vūpasamayati, caus

examples.text: evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, vūpasametabbaṃ. sabbeh'eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitabbaṃ, sannipatitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo.

70140.meaning1: quells; settles; causes to become calm; causes to subside

examples.text: ayam'pi kho, bhikkhave, ān'āpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo c'eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppann'uppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasameyya, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.

70141.commentary: (VIN) ehāyye imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamehī'ti ehāyye imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vinicchehi.

examples.text: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasameyya, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.
siyā'pi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷattāya vāḷattāya bhedāya saṃvatteyyā'ti, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, evarūpaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasametuṃ.

70143.meaning2: having appeased, having allayed, having relieved

examples.text: tass'eva sukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ sukhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppannā sukhā vedanā sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammatī'ti pajānāti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭṭā samodhānā usmā jāyati, tejo abhinibbattati, tesaṃ'y'eva dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ nānābhāvā vikkhepā yā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammati.

70147.meaning1: (vinaya) is settled; is resolved; is put to bed

n'atthi jhānaṃ apaññassa, paññā n'atthi ajhāyato, yamhi jhānañ'ca paññā ca, sa ve nibbānasantike.

70150.commentary: (SNa) sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgan'ti ekacaraṃ sīhaṃ viya, ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ viya. gaṇavāsino hi pamattā honti, ekacarā appamattā, tasmā ekacarāva gahitā'ti.

examples.text: eṇijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ, app'āhāraṃ alolupaṃ, sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti
abbhokāsiko'pi hoti yathāsanthatiko, vekaṭiko'pi hoti vikaṭabhojan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, apānako'pi hoti apānakattam'anuyutto, sāyatatiyakam'pi udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharatī'ti.

70152.commentary: (PYt) saṅghāṭikoṇo dīgho'ti iminā vikaṇṇo'ti ettha visamo kaṇṇo vikaṇṇo'ti katvā kaṇṇasaddassa koṇ'atthaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ sallaṃ jānāmi yen'amhi viddho, yadi vā sallaṃ yadi vā khurappaṃ yadi vā vekaṇḍaṃ yadi vā nārācaṃ yadi vā vacchadantaṃ yadi vā karavīrapattan'ti

aṭṭhahi akkhaṇehi vajjitaṃ manussabhāvaṃ sandhāy'āha sudullabho laddho manussalābho'ti. tattha aṭṭha akkhaṇā nāma tayo apāyā arūpā asaññasattā paccantadeso indriyānaṃ vekallaṃ niyatamicchādiṭṭhikatā apātubhāvo buddhassā'ti.
kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ, vekaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro, mātāpettibharo āsiṃ, kassapassa upāsako.

70157.commentary: (MNa) vekhanaso'ti ayaṃ kira sakul'udāyissa ācariyo, so sakul'udāyī paribbājako paramavaṇṇapañhe parājito'ti sutvā mayā so sādhukaṃ uggahāpito, tenā'pi sādhukaṃ uggahitaṃ, kathaṃ nu kho parājito, hand'āhaṃ sayaṃ gantvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ paramavaṇṇapañhaṃ pucchitvā jānissāmī'ti rājagahato pañcacattālīsayojanaṃ sāvatthiṃ gantvā yena bhagavā, ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā pana ṭhitako'va bhagavato santike udānaṃ udānesi. tattha purimasadisaṃ vuttanayen'eva veditabbaṃ.
70157.notes: (MW) a Brāhman in the third stage of his life, anchorite, hermit

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. atha kho vekhanaso paribbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.

70159.commentary: (MNa) vekhanaso'ti ayaṃ kira sakul'udāyissa ācariyo, so sakul'udāyī paribbājako paramavaṇṇapañhe parājito'ti sutvā mayā so sādhukaṃ uggahāpito, tenā'pi sādhukaṃ uggahitaṃ, kathaṃ nu kho parājito, hand'āhaṃ sayaṃ gantvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ paramavaṇṇapañhaṃ pucchitvā jānissāmī'ti rājagahato pañcacattālīsayojanaṃ sāvatthiṃ gantvā yena bhagavā, ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā pana ṭhitako'va bhagavato santike udānaṃ udānesi. tattha purimasadisaṃ vuttanayen'eva veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. atha kho vekhanasso paribbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.

cakkhu, bhikkhave, purisassa samuddo, tassa rūpamayo vego.

70161.commentary: (SNa) tassa rūpamayo vego'ti samuddassa appamāṇo ūmimayo vego viya tassā'pi cakkhusamuddassa samosarantassa nīl'ādibhedassa ārammaṇassa vasena appameyyo rūpamayo vego veditabbo.

examples.text: mano, bhikkhave, purisassa samuddo, tassa dhammamayo vego. yo taṃ dhammamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atari manosamuddaṃ saūmiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo'ti.

atha kho vegabbhari devaputto ākoṭakaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāya paccabhāsi

70164.commentary: (MNa) sitaṃ pātv'ākāsī'ti mahāmaggena gacchanto aññataraṃ bhūmippadesaṃ oloketvā, atthi nu kho mayā cariyaṃ caramānena imasmiṃ ṭhāne nivutthapubban'ti āvajjanto addasa, kassapabuddhakāle imasmiṃ ṭhāne vegaḷiṅgaṃ nāma gāmanigamo ahosi, ahaṃ tadā jotipālo nāma māṇavo ahosiṃ, mayhaṃ sahāyo ghaṭikāro nāma kumbhakāro ahosi, tena saddhiṃ mayā idha ekaṃ sukāraṇaṃ kataṃ, taṃ bhikkhusaṅghassa apākaṭaṃ paṭicchannaṃ, handa naṃ bhikkhusaṅghassa pākaṭaṃ karomī'ti maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ padese ṭhitako'va sitapātukammamakāsi, aggaggadante dassetvā mandahasitaṃ hasi.

examples.text: na akāraṇena tathāgatā sitaṃ pātukarontī'ti. bhūtapubbaṃ, ānanda, imasmiṃ padese vegaḷiṅgaṃ nāma gāmanigamo ahosi iddho c'eva phīto ca bahujano ākiṇṇamanusso.

vegāyita + tta

kaṅkhī vecikicchī āgamaṃ, pañhe pucchituṃ abhikaṅkhamāno, tes'antakaro bhavāhi pañhe me puṭṭho, anupubbaṃ anudhammaṃ byākarohi me.
yo vejayantapāsādaṃ, pād'aṅguṭṭhena kampayi, tādisaṃ bhikkhum'āsajja, kaṇha dukkhaṃ nigacchasi.
so kho ahaṃ, mārisa moggallāna, taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tato paṭinivattitvā vejayantaṃ nāma pāsādaṃ māpesiṃ. vejayantassa kho, mārisa moggallāna, pāsādassa ekasataṃ niyyūhaṃ.

70170.meaning1: name of a king Mahāsudassana's chariot
70170.commentary: (SNa) vejayantarathappamukhānī'ti ettha vejayanto nāma tassa rañño ratho, yassa cakkānaṃ indanīlamaṇimayā nābhi, sattaratanamayā arā, pavāḷamayā nemi, rajatamayo akkho, indanīlamaṇimayaṃ upakkharaṃ, rajatamayaṃ kubbaraṃ. so tesaṃ rathānaṃ pamukho aggo.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītirathasahassāni ahesuṃ sovaṇṇ'ālaṅ'kārāni sovaṇṇaddhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni vejayantarathappamukhāni.
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā rathasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so ratho hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena abhiruhāmi, vejayanto ratho.

70171.commentary: (THa) vejayantapāsādan'ti so vejayantapāsādo tāvatiṃsabhavane yojanasahassubbedho anekasahassa-niyyūha-kūṭ'āgāra-paṭimaṇḍito dev'āsurasaṅgāme asure jinitvā sakke devānam'inde nagaramajjhe ṭhite uṭṭhito vijayantena nibbattattā vejayanto'ti laddhanāmo pāsādo, taṃ sandhāy'āha vejayantapāsādan'ti.

examples.text: yo vejayantapāsādaṃ, pād'aṅguṭṭhena kampayi, tādisaṃ bhikkhum'āsajja, kaṇha dukkhaṃ nigacchasi.
yo vejayantapāsāde, sakkaṃ so paripucchati, api āvuso jānāsi, taṇhakkhayavimuttiyo, tassa sakko viyākāsi, pañhaṃ puṭṭho yathātathaṃ.
